fact: A Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy presentation lists the Government Open Data Strategy 2024-2027 among The Gambia's policies, strategies and legal frameworks, and says it was developed with the e-Governance Academy of Estonia under the AU-EU D4D Hub; it gives no approval date and also headlines it as 'Open Data Strategy (2023-2026)', and the document's date is its published year 2025.
The World Bank's GovTech dataset (2025 round) records no open data portal for The Gambia, as the publisher's own assessment; the line gives no other year, so the survey round's year is used.
